shortDescription: Chevron NYSE:CVX said on Tuesday it was transporting non-essential personnel from its offshore platforms in the Gulf of Mexico as a possible tropical storm approaches the US Gulf Coast.The oil major said the move was precautionary and did not immediately indicate any impact on production.
